description:
Kaito Kid declares his intent to steal the Siren Splash, a crown embedded with one of the world`s largest tourmalines. However, Suzuki Jirokichi is confident in his newest anti-Kid device, the Fujin Road. As the clock counts down to Kid`s arrival, will Conan the Kid Killer once against be able to stop the Reiwa Wizard?
Source: crunchyroll

titles.title: Kaito Kid and the Crown Trick (Part 1)
